data.description: Collection of unicellular organism records in the clade Diatomeae, comprising several genera of algae, specifically microalgae, found in the oceans, waterways and soils of the world.
Collection of biological records (material or observations) not limited to a single discipline. May be appropriate for teaching, host, or comparative collections.
Collection of botanical records, including algae, fungi, vascular and non-vascular plants, cyanobacteria.
Collection of cultural records, including archives, art, anthropological, archaeological, ethnographic, history, library, document, and media material.
Collection of records that include earth sciences, meteoritics, rocks, and minerals.
Collection of entomological records that may include arthropods and insects.
Collection of environmental records that may include water, soil, and eDNA samples.
Collection of general records not specific to any of the other categories. This also includes the Arctos:Entity collection.
Collection of amphibian and reptile records.
Collection of invertebrate records, exclusive of entomological records (e.g., arthropods and insects) or malacological records.
Collection of mollusk records, including snails, clams, octopuses, etc.
Collection of bird egg and nest records.
Collection of parasite records. For records of the host, use Biological.
